_readme: Hand-added events. The weekly refresh keeps these until they end. Same fields as events.json.

events.name: Fleet Week air show
events.note: Free viewing on the Marina Green. Jets are very loud, so bring ear protection for little ones. Strong wind may cut today's show short.

events.name: Fleet Week air show
events.note: Free viewing on the Marina Green. Jets are very loud, so bring ear protection for little ones.

events.name: Big Truck Bonanza
events.note: The Alameda library's touch-a-truck event, held every other year. Meet police, fire and utility trucks in the City Hall lot across from the Main Library.

events.name: Indigenous Peoples Day Powwow and Indian Market
events.note: Berkeley's 33rd annual celebration with dancing, Native foods, and arts and crafts. Free and wheelchair accessible.

events.area: Chabot Space and Science Center, Oakland hills
events.name: Family Nature Adventures: Spidey Spectacular
events.note: A family program all about spiders. Check the listing for ages and tickets.

events.area: San Francisco County Fair Building, Golden Gate Park
events.name: Children's Business Fair
events.note: About 40 kid entrepreneurs selling crafts and creations at their own booths.

events.name: Dads with Strollers meetup
events.note: A walk-and-talk for dads, with coffee and donuts. Meets at the lower children's playground.

events.name: Storytime Science: Halloween
events.note: A Halloween storybook read-aloud with a related hands-on activity, aimed at ages 4 to 8 and their grown-ups. Included with admission.

events.name: Storytime Science: Halloween
events.note: A Halloween storybook read-aloud with a related hands-on activity, aimed at ages 4 to 8 and their grown-ups. Included with admission.

events.name: Storytime Science: Halloween
events.note: A Halloween storybook read-aloud with a related hands-on activity for young children and their grown-ups. The museum opens to the public at noon on Sundays. Included with admission.

events.name: Storytime Science: Halloween
events.note: A Halloween storybook read-aloud with a related hands-on activity for young children and their grown-ups. The museum opens to the public at noon on Sundays. Included with admission.

events.name: Fleet Week Family Day at India Basin
events.note: Free bayfront festival with a brass band concert, boat rides, games and kids' giveaways. It's right on the water, so dress for wind.

events.name: Fleet Fest at Fisherman's Wharf
events.note: Navy bands and food trucks on the waterfront. Expect big crowds during the air show.

events.name: Italian Heritage Festival and Parade
events.note: San Francisco's long-running parade celebrating the Italian-American community. Expect crowds and street closures.

events.name: Jack London Square Farmers Market
events.note: Waterfront farmers market with room for strollers.

events.name: K9 Heroes demonstration (Fleet Week)
events.note: Working dogs show their skills, followed by a Navy brass band at 11.

events.name: Fan-built Lego brick exhibition
events.note: A large display of fan-created Lego builds. Check the listing for hours and admission.

events.name: Model Boats on Parade
events.note: Dozens of model boats on display and sailing the lake, with a sailboat race at 1 pm.

events.name: Banned Books Week Family Storytime
events.note: A special storytime with playtime afterward. All ages welcome.

events.name: Toddler Storytime
events.note: Songs, rhymes and stories for 18 months to 3 years. Monday is Indigenous Peoples' Day, so confirm the library is open before you go.

events.name: Off the Grid on Treasure Island
events.note: Food trucks with big skyline views. The island is very exposed on windy days.

events.name: Second Saturdays: Bollywood Garba
events.note: Free outdoor dance celebration. No RSVP needed.

events.name: YBG Dance Day
events.note: Free drop-in dance classes until 1:30 pm, then performances on the Great Lawn.

events.name: Oakland Rising: Follow the Music (live)
events.note: Free live music on the Great Lawn from a youth arts education group. RSVP suggested.

events.name: Shotwell Community Lantern Parade
events.note: Bring a lantern, drums or noisemakers. Gather at 7, the parade heads down Shotwell at 7:30, returns at 24th around 8:10, and finishes at Shotwell and 20th around 8:30.

events.name: Mission Science Workshop free open house
events.area: Mission Science Workshop, 3750 18th St (Church St between 17th and 18th)
events.note: The workshop's free monthly Saturday open house, with Halloween basket making and geode breaking today plus the usual hands-on science and live animals. Today's details came from a neighbor, so check the workshop's page or call (415) 621-1240 to confirm.

events.name: Indigenous Peoples Day at Yerba Buena Gardens
events.note: Free all-ages celebration with Native American art, music and vendors, headlined by Jeremy Dutcher. Bring a picnic; free RSVP.

events.name: Indigenous Peoples' Day at The Lawrence
events.area: Lawrence Hall of Science, Berkeley hills
events.note: The science center opens on the holiday (it's usually closed Mondays), with its play space for ages 2 to 6. Listed by 510 Families; check The Lawrence's site for the day's programs and hours.

events.name: Exploratorium open on Indigenous Peoples' Day
events.note: A rare Monday opening for the holiday. Check the museum's calendar for hours before you go.

events.name: Paseo Artístico 10th Anniversary Block Party
events.note: Free outdoor block party for the Mission's bilingual art walk: a live music stage, kids' activities, community murals and arts and crafts vendors. Mission District Young Musicians play around noon, and Fogo Na Roupa closes the stage at 5:30.

events.name: Wine tasting with Christopher Renfro at Hawk Creek Farm
events.area: Hawk Creek Farm, 203 Cotter St (Mission Terrace)
events.note: A local winemaker's tasting with small bites and a chance to harvest vegetables and herbs to take home. Family-friendly: adults $50, children $10; space is limited.

events.name: All-ages backyard beekeeping workshop at Hawk Creek Farm
events.area: Hawk Creek Farm, 203 Cotter St (Mission Terrace)
events.note: Hands-on beekeeping with the farm's resident beekeepers. Kids under 9 need an adult taking part too; fee covers materials. Rescheduled if it rains; registration on the farm's site.

events.name: Tiny Dances: Swan Lake (SF Ballet)
events.note: San Francisco Ballet's new family series for ages 2 to 8: an hour of Swan Lake in two halves with an intermission, plus pre-show lobby activities and a chance for kids to dance.

events.name: Tiny Dances: Swan Lake (SF Ballet)
events.note: San Francisco Ballet's new family series for ages 2 to 8: an hour of Swan Lake in two halves with an intermission, plus pre-show lobby activities and a chance for kids to dance. This show is sensory friendly.

events.name: Tiny Dances: Swan Lake (SF Ballet)
events.note: San Francisco Ballet's new family series for ages 2 to 8: an hour of Swan Lake in two halves with an intermission, plus pre-show lobby activities and a chance for kids to dance.

events.name: Tiny Dances: Swan Lake (SF Ballet)
events.note: San Francisco Ballet's new family series for ages 2 to 8: an hour of Swan Lake in two halves with an intermission, plus pre-show lobby activities and a chance for kids to dance.

events.name: Family Matters: ODC/Dance
events.note: ODC's free one-hour Sunday dance series for families, mixing performance, participation, and a chance to meet the artists.

events.name: Family Matters at ODC
events.note: ODC's free one-hour Sunday dance series for families, mixing performance, participation, and a chance to meet the artists.

events.name: The Velveteen Rabbit (ODC/Dance)
events.note: ODC/Dance's holiday family favorite, based on the children's book. Runs Nov 28 through Dec 6; see ODC's calendar for every show.

events.name: The Velveteen Rabbit (ODC/Dance)
events.note: ODC/Dance's holiday family favorite, based on the children's book. Runs Nov 28 through Dec 6; see ODC's calendar for every show.

events.name: Luna Mexicana (Oakland Ballet)
events.note: Oakland Ballet's Día de los Muertos celebration with ballet, Ballet Folklórico, live mariachi, and ofrendas in the lobby. Recommended for ages 7 and up; tickets required.

events.name: Luna Mexicana (Oakland Ballet)
events.note: Oakland Ballet's Día de los Muertos celebration with ballet, Ballet Folklórico, live mariachi, and ofrendas in the lobby. Recommended for ages 7 and up; tickets required. This is the matinee.

events.name: Ballet Book Club
events.note: Ballet-themed stories and movement for ages 2 to 6.

events.name: Monday Fun Day Family Dance Party
events.note: A dance party for babies, toddlers, preschoolers, and their grown-ups.

events.name: Family Dance Party
events.note: A dance party for the whole family at the Bernal Heights branch.

events.name: Line Dancing (all ages)
events.note: Learn some line dances together; open to all ages.

events.name: Halloween Family Dance Party
events.note: Costumes welcome at this Halloween dance party for families.

events.name: Halloween Family Dance Party
events.note: A Halloween dance party for ages 0 to 5 and their caregivers; costumes welcome.

events.name: Line Dancing (all ages)
events.note: Learn some line dances together; open to all ages.

events.name: Nutcracker Sweets Ballet (Mark Foehringer Dance Project)
events.note: A short, kid-sized Nutcracker in the Children's Creative Center.

events.name: Monday Fun Day Family Dance Party
events.note: A dance party for babies, toddlers, preschoolers, and their grown-ups.

events.name: Nutcracker Sweets Ballet (Mark Foehringer Dance Project)
events.note: A short, kid-sized Nutcracker for families.

events.name: SFJAZZ Family Matinee: Marcus Shelby & Friends, Bebop Legends
events.note: An all-ages jazz matinee on the moods of the bebop era. Tickets $10 to $20.

events.name: SFJAZZ Family Matinee: Mariachi Flor de Toloache
events.note: An all-ages matinee with the Grammy-winning all-women mariachi band. Family matinees are usually at 11 am; confirm the time with SFJAZZ.

events.name: SFJAZZ Family Matinee: A Charlie Brown Christmas
events.note: The Adam Shulman Trio and the San Francisco Girls Chorus play Vince Guaraldi's holiday classic. Family matinees are usually at 11 am; confirm the time with SFJAZZ.

events.name: SF Symphony: Music for Families
events.note: A classical concert designed for families, recommended for ages 5 to 12. Kids' tickets are half off, and past concerts have had an instrument petting zoo in the lobby beforehand.

events.name: Rock and Roll Playhouse: Music of The Beatles
events.area: Henry J. Kaiser Center for the Arts, Oakland
events.note: An hour-long kids' concert with singing, dancing, and games, for ages 10 and under, with the volume turned down. $24; under 1 free.

events.name: Rockin' Holiday with Alphabet Rockers
events.area: Henry J. Kaiser Center for the Arts, Oakland
events.note: A family holiday celebration with the Grammy-nominated kids' hip-hop group.

events.name: Halloween Hoopla (Children's Garden Series)
events.note: Free interactive Halloween shows for kids under 10 and their grown-ups in the Children's Garden. Costumes welcome.

events.name: Joe Bataan at Yerba Buena Gardens
events.note: Free outdoor afternoon concert by the Latin soul and boogaloo legend. Bring a picnic for the lawn.

events.name: Afro-Filipino Jazz Project at Yerba Buena Gardens
events.note: Free outdoor jazz on the lawn.

events.name: Dance Outdoors with Rhythm & Motion
events.note: A free, upbeat outdoor dance workout open to everyone at Yerba Buena Gardens.

events.name: Dance Outdoors with Rhythm & Motion
events.note: A free, upbeat outdoor dance workout open to everyone at Yerba Buena Gardens.

events.name: Dance Outdoors with Rhythm & Motion

events.name: Bhangra & Beats Night Market
events.note: Free evening market with bhangra music and dancing at Yerba Buena Gardens.

events.name: Cajón Drum Circle with Cunamacué
events.note: Bang out rhythms on the cajón, the Peruvian box drum, in a family drum circle.

events.name: Cajón Drum Circle with Cunamacué
events.note: Bang out rhythms on the cajón, the Peruvian box drum, in a family drum circle.

events.name: Mariela's Music Time
events.note: A music time for young kids and their grown-ups.

events.name: René y Familia
events.note: A family music performance.

events.name: René y Familia
events.note: A family music performance.

events.name: The Sampaguitas
events.note: A family concert at the Mission Bay branch.

events.name: Malinky Music
events.note: Music time for babies, toddlers, and preschoolers.

events.name: Guitar Sing-Along with Grandpa Alan
events.note: Sing along to guitar with Grandpa Alan.

events.name: Mark Foehringer's Nutcracker Sweets
events.note: A short, kid-sized Nutcracker ballet.

events.name: Nutcracker Sweets Ballet (Mark Foehringer Dance Project)
events.note: A short, kid-sized Nutcracker ballet.

events.name: Nutcracker Sweets Ballet (Mark Foehringer Dance Project)
events.note: A short, kid-sized Nutcracker ballet.

events.name: Halloween Party & Costume Parade
events.note: CMC's annual Halloween spooktacular with a costume parade. Free; bring a small snack or drink to share if you can.

events.name: Día de Muertos en la Misión (Community Music Center)
events.note: A Día de Muertos concert by CMC faculty musicians. Sliding scale $5 to $15; no one turned away for lack of funds.

events.name: Loco Bloco presents Día de los Muertos: Esto No Se Vende
events.note: Loco Bloco's annual celebration with altars in the Brava lobby, Aztec dance, a stage show by the youth drum and dance company, and a procession. Last year: altars 11 to 4, blessing at 4, show at 5 ($10), procession at 7. Check Brava for this year's times.

events.name: Día de los Muertos Procession in the Mission
events.area: Starts at 22nd St and Bryant St
events.note: The Mission's big annual procession, led by Aztec dancers, with music and painted faces along 24th Street. It's held every Nov 2 at 7 pm; this year's details aren't posted yet.

events.name: Festival of Altars (Marigold Project)
events.note: Community altars in the park through the day, with workshops and performances later. Held every Nov 2; this year's schedule isn't posted yet.

events.name: A Sense of Belonging: art workshop with Mabel Valdiviezo
events.area: Galería de la Raza Studio 24, 2857 24th St
events.note: A community collage and painting workshop at Galería de la Raza. Check the listing for ages.

events.name: Classic Mural Walk with Precita Eyes
events.area: Precita Eyes Mural Arts Center, 2981 24th St
events.note: A walking tour of the Mission's murals with longtime Precita Eyes muralist Patricia Rose, about 1.5 hours. Book ahead on Precita Eyes' site.

events.name: Classic Mural Walk with Precita Eyes
events.area: Precita Eyes Mural Arts Center, 2981 24th St
events.note: A walking tour of the Mission's murals with longtime Precita Eyes muralist Patricia Rose, about 1.5 hours. Book ahead on Precita Eyes' site.

events.name: Classic Mural Walk with Precita Eyes
events.area: Precita Eyes Mural Arts Center, 2981 24th St
events.note: A walking tour of the Mission's murals with longtime Precita Eyes muralist Patricia Rose, about 1.5 hours. Book ahead on Precita Eyes' site.

events.name: Brava! Block Party
events.note: A free street party for Brava's 40th anniversary, with live performances, film screenings, and art activations on 24th Street. Check Brava's site for the full schedule.

events.name: Dragons Love Tacos, the Musical (PLAY Theatre)
events.area: Creativity Theater, Children's Creativity Museum, 221 4th St
events.note: A musical of the picture book, with toe-tapping songs and a scene-stealing dog. Recommended for ages 3 and up; about an hour with a 10-minute intermission. $5 to $39; kids under 2 free. The run ends Oct 18.
